area_subtitle: União das freguesias de Oeiras e São Julião da Barra etc.
description:
A 2-minute walk from the train station that takes you to downtown Lisbon in 20 minutes and 
5 minutes' walk to the sea, 
this space is a true historical retreat, almost 90 years old.
 It has been meticulously decorated, respecting the dazzling tiles and original architectural details that tell stories.
Imagine waking up in an environment where the charm of the last century blends harmoniously with contemporary comfort. Free Street Parking
